query:
SELECT u.id as user_id, u.name, u.email, cp.id as profile_id, cp.firstName, cp.lastName, cp.sageStatus, cp.viaStatus, cp.ipipStatus, cp.interviewStatus
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.userId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%Amanda%' OR u.email LIKE '%amanda%' OR u.email LIKE '%lord%'
ORDER BY u.id DESC;
